description: Splits a signal at zero and scales its positive and negative halves by separate amounts, with each half also available on its own output

params.text: Scales the part of the signal below zero, -1 to +1; below zero it folds that part above the line instead
Attenuverts the CV scaling the part below zero, -1 to +1
Scales the part of the signal at or above zero, -1 to +1; below zero it folds that part below the line instead
Attenuverts the CV scaling the part at or above zero, -1 to +1
Scales the whole signal before it is split, -1 to +1, inverting it below zero
Attenuverts the CV scaling the whole signal, -1 to +1
AC passes the outputs through a DC blocking filter; DC leaves in the offset that unequal halves produce

inputs.text: The signal to be split and scaled
Shifts the scaling of the part below zero, through its own attenuverter
Shifts the scaling of the part at or above zero, through its own attenuverter
Shifts the scaling of the whole signal, through its own attenuverter

outputs.text: Both halves at their set levels, joined back into one signal
The part of the signal below zero at its set level, and 0V whenever the signal is at or above zero
The part of the signal at or above zero at its set level, and 0V whenever the signal is below zero
10V whenever the signal is below zero
10V whenever the signal is at or above zero
